context: Tests whether the skill produces a Koog 1.0-correct scaffold for an OpenAI-backed agent: current artifact coordinates, top-level factory, JDK 17 toolchain, env-var-driven key, and absence of redundant defaults.

checklist.name: Uses 1.0+ umbrella coordinate
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts declares an `ai.koog:koog-agents` dependency at version 1.0.0 or later. Not 0.7.x, not a partial set of submodules when the umbrella covers them

checklist.name: Targets JDK 17 toolchain
checklist.description: Configures a Kotlin JVM toolchain at JDK 17 (jvmToolchain(17) or kotlin { jvmToolchain(17) }). 1.0 requires it

checklist.name: Uses top-level AIAgent factory
checklist.description: Main.kt calls AIAgent(...) as a top-level factory function with named parameters (promptExecutor, llmModel, systemPrompt) — not AIAgent.invoke, not a concrete subtype constructor

checklist.name: Reads API key from environment
checklist.description: Reads OPENAI_API_KEY (or equivalent) from System.getenv(...). The literal API key is never embedded in the source file

checklist.name: Wires simpleOpenAIExecutor and a current OpenAI model
checklist.description: Uses simpleOpenAIExecutor as the prompt executor and selects an OpenAIModels.Chat.* entry that exists in 1.0 (e.g., GPT4o, GPT5 family) — not a retired model

checklist.name: Omits the default singleRunStrategy
checklist.description: Does NOT pass strategy = singleRunStrategy() to the factory — it's the default; explicit listing adds noise and the rules in this plugin discourage it for the demo scaffold

checklist.name: Runs the agent inside runBlocking
checklist.description: main() uses runBlocking { ... } (or an equivalent coroutine entry point) since agent.run is suspending

checklist.name: Initializes git in the new directory
checklist.description: Runs git init in the target directory and includes a sensible .gitignore covering Gradle output (build/, .gradle/) and IDE files

checklist.name: Application plugin wired with mainClass
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts applies the application plugin and sets mainClass.set("...") so `./gradlew run` works
